capture: Real current-app iPhone footage for editing and additions. Removal consequences and iPad Pencil guidance are explanatory cards over the owner-supplied wall photo, not captured app UI. See docs/help-clips.md.

scenes.title: Check the rings
scenes.body: Select a dashed ring, then Keep. Resize a selected ring with minus or plus.

scenes.title: Mark a missed hold
scenes.body: Choose Add, then Draw. Trace around the hold, or tap for a circle. Use two fingers to pan and zoom.

scenes.title: Build an outline
scenes.body: Choose Corners. Tap at least three points around the hold, then Finish. Undo removes the last corner.

scenes.title: Trace the shape
scenes.body: Select a hold that is on, then Trace to draw a replacement outline around it.

scenes.title: Refine an edge
scenes.body: Use Refine to adjust an outline. Changing a published outline can mark climbs as missing a hold.

scenes.title: Join split rings
scenes.body: Use Join when one hold has several rings. Joining published holds also affects climbs using them.

scenes.title: Come back anytime
scenes.body: Boards → your wall → Climbs. Open the wall name, then Edit holds. Add anything you missed.

scenes.title: Publish the additions
scenes.body: Tap Publish holds when ready. Adding missed holds leaves existing climbs unchanged.

scenes.title: A hold is used?
scenes.body: Remove or switch off a hold used by published climbs, then Publish holds. Keep holds cancels the warning; Remove anyway publishes.

scenes.title: Climbs stay available
scenes.body: Affected climbs show a missing-hold warning. Logged ascents stay. Remix makes an updated climb, leaving the original.

scenes.title: Apple Pencil on iPad
scenes.body: Full-width editor: draw, tap for circles or toggle marks. Pencil only turns on unless you changed it. Fingers still select, pan and zoom.
